intent: Distinguish and relate Notes-owned research evidence to Trade Journal investment claims and theses without duplicating provenance-bearing claims or silently exercising investment judgment.
contract: Given an explicit Notes-owned Trade Journal research-insight handoff, load a deterministic SHA-256-bound context in which Notes/Tana owns capture, source material, and Toulmin extraction while Trade Journal owns promoted investment entities and their governed relationships; keep source evidence, existing main claims, synthesized investment claims, and proposed thesis mappings exactly distinct; deterministically reuse any existing main claim with exact (sourceInsightId, sourceClaimId) provenance; preserve counterarguments, qualifiers, and source provenance; consider direct semantic bearing across developing and monitoring asset or macro theses without treating ticker or keyword overlap as proof; return a bounded recommendation-only result with explicit ambiguity and no writes; validate the result against the exact context digest; and report unavailable source, database, environment, or provider states without invented context or mutation.
instructions: Require one explicit research insight ID. Prepare context only through scripts/claims-synthesis.ts --prepare --insight-id <uuid>; this deterministic repository boundary performs approved reads and exposes no write mode.

Accept a source only when its Trade Journal research artifact proves Notes/Tana provenance. Notes/Tana owns capture, source material, and Toulmin extraction; Trade Journal does not recreate those source records as new authority.

Treat source evidence, existing main claims, synthesized investment claims, and proposed thesis mappings as separate collections. Never call a source claim an investment claim until the result explicitly recommends a distinct synthesis or reuses an exact existing main claim.

For every source claim, exact (sourceInsightId, sourceClaimId) provenance is deterministic identity: reuse the existing main_claims ID even if its lifecycle is not active, and refuse any duplicate synthesized claim.

A synthesized investment claim is only a recommendation for a materially distinct investment assertion. It must retain the sourceClaimId provenance reference and preserve every source counterargument and qualifier; it is not permission to create a database row.

Judge thesis bearing against both developing and monitoring macro or asset theses. Ticker and keyword overlap are retrieval hints only and never semantic proof. Every ambiguity must name exactly one axis: claim_identity for uncertain identity or distinction, or thesis_mapping for uncertain relationship, direction, or thesis bearing. A claim_identity ambiguity must have no reused or synthesized claim resolution. A thesis_mapping ambiguity may preserve a deterministic claim resolution but must have no mapping for that source claim.

Return at most 25 recommendations, at most 25 synthesized claims, at most 25 ambiguities, and at most 5 proposed mappings per source claim. Use only supports, refutes, or foundation relationships and high, medium, or low confidence.

Set execution exactly to { mode: recommendation_only, writes: [] }. Provider adapters must not promote, create, link, or mutate claims; change thesis or signal status; resolve Decision Items; mutate strategies or positions; place or stage trades; or use ad-hoc SQL, Supabase MCP writes, direct API mutation, or any repository operation script.

Validate provider output only through scripts/claims-synthesis.ts --validate-result <file|-> --context <file>. A validation refusal, unavailable prerequisite, stale context digest, malformed output, provider failure, or sandbox denial is a complete unavailable or failed outcome, never partial success.

Unattended execution is eligible only for the same recommendation-only contract: it must preserve ambiguity, emit no writes, and stop on unavailable inputs. Any accepted persistence remains a separate explicitly authorized governed capability.

requirements.description: Each exact provider adapter is present in the governed Provider Entry Point generated from this package.

The deterministic read boundary accepts complete Notes-owned Toulmin input, cryptographically binds source content, and keeps source evidence, existing claims, and developing or monitoring thesis targets distinct.
Exact provenance forces existing-claim reuse, source-owned claims cannot be duplicated, and synthesized investment claims preserve provenance, qualifiers, and counterarguments.
Results are bounded, context-digest-bound, recommendation-only, and preserve semantic ambiguity without claim creation or thesis mapping.
The repository and provider adapters expose no ad-hoc SQL, Supabase MCP, direct API, claim, thesis/status, Decision Item, strategy, position, trade, scheduler, credential, or other write authority.
The exact Claude and Codex adapters preserve source authority, claim identity, conservative semantic bearing, result bounds, unavailable behavior, and the genuine-judgment boundary.
The configured repository runtime can execute the non-mutating CLI preflight and reports missing source, database, environment, provider, or sandbox prerequisites as explicit unavailable outcomes.
